notes: Pricing page has a monthly/annual toggle ('Billed annually (Save 20%)'); the captured view shows the annual-billed monthly equivalents ($15/$40/$75) with a struck-through and a discounted annual total ($228→$180, $588→$480, $1068→$900). Monthly-billed amounts ($19/$49/$89 implied by 228/12 etc.) are NOT displayed and must not be expected. Enterprise has no price ('Learn more'). A 'Team bundle' / 'Team & Enterprise' tier is referenced in the comparison table but shown without a price or plan card, so it is not annotated as a plan (a model reporting it as custom is acceptable but not required). 'Standard Scale' tab labels and discounts for non-profits are not plans. The legal entity '© 2026 Restly, Inc.' appears in the footer (legal_name is not an annotatable field here); no country, city, founding year or headcount is stated — the About page mentions Microsoft, Retool and Jet.com only as prior employers of the team. '100,000+ organizations' and G2/Product Hunt ratings are company claims, not payment proof. 'Partner integrations' (via Zapier) is incidental; core purpose is a form builder: eligible.
